purpose: Independent prop atlases only; original terrain and layout preserved.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a transparent 4-column by 3-row sprite atlas (12 separated props), ideally 2048 x 1536. Each cell identical size, object centered with generous transparent margins and bottom aligned. No labels, numbers, borders, background, colored squares, characters or UI. Real alpha transparency. Elevated front/top-down 2D RPG view matching the attached game's LAND AND BACKGROUND painting, not its old dark-outlined prop sprites. Sophisticated hand-painted pixel-art surfaces: broad readable planes, crisp silhouette, restrained clustered texture, no black cartoon outline, no glow, no blur or photorealism. Diffuse light from upper left, subdued regional shadows. Do not include a large cast shadow oval; integrate a small irregular contact footing inside each prop. Trees are natural tall trees, not ornamental bonsai: irregular sparse lower branches, crown masses with air gaps, trunks narrow and grey-brown. Maintain clear cutout silhouette. All twelve assets isolated with at least 35px gap from cell edges; never share roots across cells. Large trees occupy about 80% cell height, smaller stones/shrubs occupy about 45-60% height. Attachment is only style/palette reference; DO NOT redraw the map.
Forest biome: muted olive/moss/fern greens, soft yellow-green leaf highlights, grey-brown bark; use the upper-left forest terrain's natural color relationship. Exactly twelve assets in row-major order: row1 broad-canopy mature tree, asymmetrical oak, tall layered conifer, weeping willow; row2 subtle pink flowering cherry tree, broad green tree with small orange fruits, muted golden autumn tree, twisted leafless dead tree; row3 angular mossy boulder cluster, low irregular fern shrub, fallen hollow wood log, chopped tree stump. Individual roots and stone bases merge into small uneven moss/leaf-litter skirts. No saturated orange trunks or uniformly black leaf borders.
